description: This file defines the 'SafeScripting' module for HTMLPurifier, a PHP library that sanitizes HTML content. It extends the base HTMLModule class and sets up a 'script' element with specific attribute restrictions to ensure safe scripting practices by disallowing inline JavaScript and enforcing valid external script sources.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeScripting
classes.description: A class that enforces safe scripting policies within HTML content by disallowing inline scripts and whitelisting external script sources.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the 'SafeScripting' module by adding a 'script' element with specific restrictions for 'type' and 'src' attributes, ensuring scripts are from whitelisted sources and properly specified.
